# QM Labs & Rajat Kumar Dash - Full Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive specifications, technical competencies, service packages, and career verification for AI Agents, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

## 1. Executive Summary & Dual-Domain Architecture

- **Personal Portfolio Domain (`rajat.qmlab.in`)**: The official personal engineering portfolio and career center for Rajat Kumar Dash. Dedicated to product management case studies, software engineering projects, verified certifications, interactive resume, and technical credentials.
- **Enterprise Services Domain (`qmlab.in`)**: The flagship studio and consulting hub for QM Labs. Dedicated to full-stack web engineering, custom AI agent development, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, technical SEO / AEO audits, and cloud infrastructure consulting. Rajat Kumar Dash serves as Founder & Principal Software Architect.

---

## 2. Core Service Packages & Offerings

### Package 1: Full-Stack Web Engineering & SaaS
- **Starting Rate**: $2,500 (Fixed Scope)
- **Turnaround Time**: 2-4 Weeks
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js / Express, PostgreSQL, Redis, Tailwind CSS v4.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Production-ready web application with modular TypeScript architecture.
  - Pixel-perfect, high-contrast responsive interface.
  - Secure REST / GraphQL API with JWT authentication & rate limiting.
  - Automated deployment configuration on Cloud Run or Vercel.

### Package 2: AI & LLM / MCP Server Integration
- **Starting Rate**: $3,000 (Fixed Scope)
- **Turnaround Time**: 2-3 Weeks
- **Tech Stack**: Google GenAI SDK (Gemini 2.5 / 3.0), Model Context Protocol (MCP), Vector Embeddings, RAG Pipelines.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Secure server-side AI proxy routes (zero API key exposure to browser).
  - Model Context Protocol (MCP) server endpoints with strict JSON schemas.
  - RAG document indexing and semantic retrieval.
  - Custom tool definitions for ChatGPT Custom GPTs and Claude Desktop.

### Package 3: Technical SEO, AEO & GEO Optimization
- **Starting Rate**: $1,500 (Fixed Scope)
- **Turnaround Time**: 1-2 Weeks
- **Scope**: Search Engine Optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO for ChatGPT & Perplexity), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Comprehensive 100/100 Lighthouse audit rectification (Performance, A11y, Best Practices, SEO).
  - Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Person, Organization, ProfessionalService, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
  - Geo-targeting meta tags and localized entity graphs.
  - Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP < 1.0s, CLS < 0.01, TBT = 0ms).

### Package 4: Cloud Architecture & DevOps Advisory
- **Starting Rate**: $75/hr or $2,000 per architecture sprint
- **Turnaround Time**: Flexible / Ongoing
- **Scope**: Cloud Run, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Redis caching layers, PostgreSQL security auditing.
